_comment: Project settings of the harness hooks in .claude/hooks/harness/ (installed as .claude/harness-hooks.json; Claude Code asks a human before the agent edits anything in .claude/). Every key is optional: a missing key keeps the default from the hook. Patterns are Python regexes; a backslash is written twice in JSON.

guard._secret_dirs: Folders that hold secrets, relative and with a trailing slash. Reading anything inside is denied, by command or with the Read tool.
guard._secret_files: File names (regex for the whole name) that hold secrets. *.example files stay readable.
guard._deploy: Commands that ship code to machines. The human confirms each one.
guard._internal_hosts: Hosts inside the perimeter, one regex per host. curl, wget, scp and rsync to any other host ask the human. Add the project's servers, e.g. "10\\.20\\.30\\.\\d+" or "build\\.corp\\.example".
guard._publish: Commands that publish content (wiki, tracker, design tool, GitHub). Add the project's publishing scripts, e.g. "scripts/wiki/publish\\.sh".

stop._comment: Fast checks of the files changed since the last clean check, before the agent finishes its answer (Stop hook). A failure sends the agent back to work with the output; at most max_blocks times in a row, then the answer ends with a warning. {files} is the matching files, {file} runs the command once per file.
